mapper.sql: select achievement_id as "achievementId", management_no as "managementNo", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", teacher_name as "teacherName", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", occurred_date as "occurredDate", certification_status as "certificationStatus", (attachment_ref is not null) as "hasAttachment" from degree_completion_achievements

sql.where: deleted_yn = 'N' and evaluation_year = #{criteria.evaluationYear} and management_no ilike '%' || #{criteria.managementNo} || '%' and teacher_name ilike '%' || #{criteria.teacherName} || '%' and management_item_code = #{criteria.managementItemCode} and certification_status = #{criteria.certificationStatus}

mapper.select: order by occurred_date desc, achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.limit} offset #{criteria.offset}

select degree_completion_student_id as "degreeCompletionStudentId", degree_type as "degreeType", student_name as "studentName", thesis_title as "thesisTitle", degree_awarded_date as "degreeAwardedDate" from degree_completion_students where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by degree_completion_student_id
mapper.insert: insert into degree_completion_achievements (management_no, evaluation_year, teacher_user_id, teacher_name, management_item_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, certification_status, created_by, updated_by) values (#{managementNo}, #{evaluationYear}, #{teacherUserId}, #{teacherName}, #{managementItemCode}, #{occurredDate}, cast(#{achievementDetail} as jsonb), 'DRAFTING', #{userId}, #{userId})

insert into degree_completion_students (achievement_id, degree_type, student_name, thesis_title, degree_awarded_date, created_by, updated_by) values (#{achievementId}, #{student.degreeType}, #{student.studentName}, #{student.thesisTitle}, #{student.degreeAwardedDate}, #{userId}, #{userId})

insert into education_achievement_status_histories (achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, processed_by) values ('DEGREE_COMPLETION', #{achievementId}, 'DRAFTING', 'CREATE', #{userId})

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values ('degree_completion_achievements', cast(#{achievementId} as text), 'CREATE', 'certification_status', 'DRAFTING', #{userId}, '석·박사 배출 실적 등록', #{requestId})
